name: Review Google Maps business contact evidence with Apify and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Review business contact and website evidence

For local agencies reviewing a Google Maps business shortlist before deciding whether a website conversation is justified.

### How it works
1. Read public business listings for one search and location.
2. Check listing contact details and website evidence separately. An uncertain fetch is not proof of a missing website.
3. Update one Google Sheets row per business and search scope. Review the evidence, limitations and source link before contacting anyone.

### Setup
- [ ] Select Apify Header Auth on all five HTTP nodes: Authorization with Bearer followed by your token.
- [ ] Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 on Upsert review register.
- [ ] Create the **Business Review** tab and import the exact [header CSV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulatovicluka1989-rgb/luminar-apify-examples/main/actors/google-maps-contact-website-opportunity-leads/n8n-google-maps-review/sheet-header.csv). Set spreadsheetId.
- [ ] Set searchQuery, locationQuery and countryCode in Review settings. maximumResults allows 1–20 businesses; it is not a promised minimum.

### Reading repeated results
Run manually and sequentially. Existing keys update; unobserved older rows remain, so check observedAt. Empty results add no rows.

The template is free; Apify runs are paid. The $1 cap is a ceiling, not a run price. Repeats may be charged again. [Setup guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulatovicluka1989-rgb/luminar-apify-examples/main/actors/google-maps-contact-website-opportunity-leads/n8n-google-maps-review/README.md).

## 1. Choose businesses to review
Enter searchQuery, locationQuery and countryCode in Review settings. Add spreadsheetId and import the Business Review header before starting.

## 2. Collect Google Maps listings
Run Google Maps once starts paid work. The lower branch waits and reads that same run; it never repeats the paid start.

## 3. Check contact and website evidence
Compare delivered listing counts with coverage, charges and dataset rows. A failed website fetch remains uncertain and must not become a claim that a business needs a website.

## 4. Build the business review queue
Upsert by business identity and search scope. Read reviewAction, evidence and limitations together; MANUALLY_VERIFY_WEBSITE needs a source check, and NO_SUPPORTED_WEBSITE_PITCH is not a sales lead.
